You play a game where you and another player see the same four images but in different orders. 
Your task is to describe one image so that the other player can identify it. 
You both win if the other player picks the correct image based on your description. 

Describe the first image.

Begin your description with "Description: ". Say no more than what's absolutely needed to make the distinction. There is no need to explain your reasoning.

action.content: Description: In a simplistic 3D environment, with sharp green walls and a flat turquoise sky,creating a walled rectangular space,, the floor is a distinct flat green plane,. Centrally placed within this defined space are three cylindrical pillars of differing heights,. In the forefront is a large green sphere casting a shadow to the right due to a light source directionally impacting the image from the upper left corner.

content.content:
You play a game where you and another player see the same four images but in different orders. You also get a description from the other player describing one of the images. 
You both win if you pick the correct image based on the other player's description.

Here is the description:
Description: In a simplistic 3D environment, with sharp green walls and a flat turquoise sky,creating a walled rectangular space,, the floor is a distinct flat green plane,. Centrally placed within this defined space are three cylindrical pillars of differing heights,. In the forefront is a large green sphere casting a shadow to the right due to a light source directionally impacting the image from the upper left corner.
Which image fits the description?

Begin your selection with "Selection: ". Say only the number of your selected image (first, second, third, fourth). There is no need to explain your reasoning.
